title.narrative: Integrated people-centered eye care services at Nimule Hospital

description.narrative: Attend and offer services to all patient by age and gender with eye related condition in Nimule Hospital and Torit State Hospital

Contribute to prevention of avoidable blindness and visual impairment in in Eastern Equatoria State Increased access to quality static and inclusive eye care services and rehabilitation.Access to comprehensive and inclusive eye care services strengthened at Nimule Hospital and Torit State Hospital Access to primary eye care services strengthened in primary health centers and primary health units within Torit County.

Cordaid has experience managing eye health at Torit Hospital and communities. The ophthalmologist in the previous project will lead the technical aspect of the implementation of the project. Their expertise in the area of interventions is undisputed and this project will support to ensure continuity in provision of comprehensive eye care services to people of Eastern Equatoria. that CBM has strategically put significant investments.
